hierarchy.notes: Primary repeated-use surface: one trust-separated public usage leaderboard instrument with derived field readouts and a rank-preserving spend, credits, and operations lens.

classification.notes: Verified and self-reported aggregates are loaded and rendered as separate rank lanes.

ssa_v2.notes: Server orchestration, leaderboard interaction, pure metric-lens math, field interpretation, empty-lane guidance, and route-local styling are separate; the largest runtime source is 344 lines.

ssi.notes: Serializable board snapshots are the only server-to-client contract; the readout and metric lens derive every interpretation and bar from those same ordered rows.

sstf.notes: Focused leaderboard tests and the complete 662-test package suite cover rank preservation, accepted-record labels, verified identity semantics, metric lenses, mobile fit, the 4K two-channel broadcast wall, empty lanes, and degraded states.

spe.notes: The default table is capped at 25 rows, the hero chart at 10 rows, and field interpretation stays linear in the visible lane size.

srs.notes: Leaderboard query failures are captured by VTRS before the public degraded state renders; derived interpretation is visibly labelled as zero rank weight.

ssra.notes: Production deploy 6a56fe41c587b657e5ca3840 passes live verified-row, accepted-record, mobile, desktop, and 3840px 4K checks with no overflow, failed requests, or console errors. At 4K the primary surface expands from 1680px to 2640px and aligns the derived readout and rank-preserving runway as equal 1319px channels.

sas.notes: The route owns one explicit manifest boundary with isolated client, pure interpretation, and style components.

sva.notes: The client receives public formatted aggregates only and never a privileged client.

srls.notes: Production aggregate views are public read-only and verified/self-reported ranks remain separate.

sev.notes: Only public Supabase URL and anonymous key variables are used by the data adapter.

ssc.notes: Dependencies are inherited from the web package and checked by the release audit.

sai.notes: Lease, intent, decision, and source commit are recorded.
